reasoning: Iran has threatened to close the Strait of Hormuz multiple times but has never actually done so, despite having the capability. The strait is critical for global oil supplies (~20% of world trade). A closure would severely damage Iran's own economy and invite military intervention. While Iran-US tensions have escalated, a complete closure remains unlikely. Partial disruptions or selective interdiction are more plausible but still represent significant escalation. The resolution criteria allow for YES even with some traffic continuing, lowering the threshold somewhat.
